_readme: This file drives resources/index.html. Edit THIS, never the HTML.
Add a group for each kind of thing you want to hand out. Groups render
in the order they appear here, and so do the items inside them.
group.title        heading shown above the group
group.note         one muted line under the heading, optional
kind         badge text: Notebook / Slides / Link / PDF / Dataset / Sheet
description  one or two sentences, optional
day          small label on the right, e.g. 'Day 3' or 'Optional'
href         where the card links. RELATIVE for files in this repo
https:// only for genuinely external things.
download     true to force a download instead of opening in the tab
extra        { label, href } for a second link on the same card
To add a file: drop it in resources/handouts/ and point href at
An empty items list is fine — the group renders with a placeholder line.
